meta.name: competitor-research
meta.description: Research competitor products, launch history, and acquisition evidence from public sources or supplied materials. Use when evaluating growth claims, comparing competitors, or choosing growth experiments. Produces a cited brief that separates observations, attributed claims, estimates, and hypotheses.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理竞品发布历史与增长证据,产出带出处的调研简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正评估对手的增长数据、要决定下一个增长实验怎么押
copy.tagline_en: Turn competitor launch history and growth evidence into a cited brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're weighing rival growth claims and picking your next experiment

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用公开网页或你提供的材料调研竞品,产出带引用的简报,把已观察事实、来源说法、估算和假设分开标注,并给出与证据挂钩的实验建议。
howto.when: 当你要评估竞品的增长说法、做竞品对比、挑选增长实验时触发;当你给出竞品网址或材料要求调研,它也会接管。

say.text: 用 competitor-research 查一下这个竞品网址,只用公开来源。
say.note: 它会先确认研究问题和范围再开始。

say.text: 把装机量和付费用户分开,给我两周内能跑的实验。
say.note: 只会给有证据支持、且符合你条件的测试。

say.text: 这些是我提供的材料,只基于它们出简报。
say.note: 简报会标注为仅基于所供材料。

howto.what_en: Claude researches competitors from public sources or your supplied files, producing a cited brief that separates observed facts, attributed claims, estimates, and hypotheses, plus evidence-tied experiment suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you evaluate growth claims, compare competitors, or choose growth experiments, or when you point it at a competitor URL or supply materials to research.

say_en.text: Use competitor-research on this competitor URL, public sources only.
say_en.note: It first fixes the research question and scope.

say_en.text: Separate installs from paid users, and give me tests I can run in two weeks.
say_en.note: Only evidence-backed tests within your constraints.

say_en.text: These are my supplied materials; base the brief only on them.
